name: io.github.Misar-AI/misarblog-mcp
title: Misar.Blog MCP Server
description: Publish and manage articles, series, comments, reactions, newsletters and blog analytics.

environmentVariables.name: MISARBLOG_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Misar.Blog API key (mbk_…). Create one at https://www.misar.blog/dashboard/settings/api-keys, or omit it and run the "login" tool to authenticate via browser.

environmentVariables.name: MISARBLOG_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Only needed for self-hosted instances.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Misar.Blog API key. Format: Bearer mbk_… — create one at https://www.misar.blog/dashboard/settings/api-keys
